name: Pillar Stone
description: Stand a charged stone upright like a pillar and draw a steady push of qi from it.

name: Pillar Guard
description: Raise a broad column of force before the body and take the blow against its face.

name: Pillar Cord
description: Stretch a cord of qi between two pillars and hold the foe against it.

name: Pillar Flare
description: Flare both pillars at once so a heavy wave rolls out between them.

name: Pillar Hold
description: Hold the pillars firm and let their weight press on the qi of the foe between them.

name: Pillar Leap
description: Leap from the foot of one pillar to the other on a spring of stored qi.

name: Pillar Array
description: Raise an array on two pillars that shocks any foe who crosses between them.

name: Pillar Lattice
description: Hold a lattice between the pillars that shields the maker and spreads the weight of every blow.

name: Pillar Draw
description: Draw a heavy strike into the foot of a pillar and bury its force in the ground.

name: Twin Crush
description: Raise two great pillars of qi that close together and crush every foe caught between them.

name: Stoop Stone
description: Set a stone on a height and draw its stored fall of qi into the maker's arms.

name: Wing Plate
description: Spread a wide plate of qi from each shoulder and take the blow across both.

name: Talon Cord
description: Throw a hooked cord of qi that grips a foe's limb and does not let go.

name: Talon Flare
description: Flare a spread of hooked marks that rake the ground below the array.

name: Wing Seal
description: Seal the air above a foe with two sheets of qi so that the foe cannot leap or rise.

name: Current Hold
description: Follow the current of a foe's qi with a held mark and press it flat as it runs.

name: Wing Step
description: Glide down a slope of laid marks with the arms spread and land on both feet.

name: Talon Array
description: Lay an array of hooked marks that rise and clutch the first foe to step across.

name: Wing Lattice
description: Hold a lattice shaped like folded wings that turns each blow along its lines and out wide.

name: Stoop Flash
description: Fall along a line of marks in one stoop and land at the far end before the foe can turn.

name: Raptor Fall
description: Let the array drop a hawk of qi from its height onto the foe with the weight of the whole fall.

name: Crown Stone
description: Set a stone on the crown of the head and let a steady charge run down the spine.

name: Crest Plate
description: Raise a plate in a high crest above the head and shed blows down its slope.

name: Rim Cord
description: Run a rim of cord about the foe's shoulders and draw it in a notch at a time.

name: Halo Glyph
description: Hold a halo of glyphs about the head that flicker toward every nearby source of qi.

name: Crown Flare
description: Flare the crown outward in a bright ring that knocks foes back a pace.

name: Crest Seal
description: Press a crest seal on a foe's brow so that its qi cannot rise to the head.

name: Rim Hold
description: Close a rim of held qi about the foe and press inward evenly.

name: Rune Step
description: Step within the halo and let it carry the body on to a new footing.

name: Crown Array
description: Lay an array about the maker in the shape of a crown that shocks the foes who close in.

name: Halo Matrix
description: Hold a halo matrix that presses on the qi of every foe who stands within its ring.

name: Halo Mend
description: Hold a halo about an ally that closes wounds while it shields the ally from further blows.

name: Paired Crown
description: Raise a crown on each track of the Core so that foes within are pressed and held while the maker stands crowned.

name: Tack Stone
description: Tack a stone to the belt and draw a steady charge of qi from the bearing it holds.

name: Oath Plate
description: Hold a plate that has been sworn to the body so it will not drop in a blow.

name: Lashing Cord
description: Lash a cord of qi round a foe's wrists and hold it to the maker's bearing.

name: Tack Flare
description: Flare the tacked marks together so a short sharp wave spreads from the maker.

name: Oath Seal
description: Seal a foe's hands with the maker's oath so that they cannot close on a weapon.

name: Windside Step
description: Step to the windward side along a laid mark and come in on the foe's blind flank.

name: Oath Lattice
description: Lay a lattice sworn to the maker that tightens on any foe who steps into it.

name: Windward Matrix
description: Hold a matrix on the windward side that turns blows aside and leaves the maker free to move.

name: Oath Draw
description: Draw a striking force into the sworn mark and hold it there as the oath is held.

name: Sworn Bearing
description: Lay a formation sworn to a bearing that binds every foe who steps across the heading.

name: Zephyr Stone
description: Set a stone that hums in the wind and lends the maker a light fast charge.

name: Gust Plate
description: Raise a plate on a gust of qi that cushions the force of a blow.

name: Billow Cord
description: Cast a cord that billows round the foe like a sail and then pulls tight.

name: Zephyr Flare
description: Flare the zephyr marks so that a low fast wave runs across the ground.

name: Billow Hold
description: Hold a billowing sheet of qi over a foe and press it slowly to the ground.

name: Gust Seal
description: Seal a gust into a mark and set it on a foe so the gust frees itself on the next move.

name: Zephyr Step
description: Ride a light wind between laid marks and cross the open ground in three strides.

name: Zephyr Array
description: Lay an array of open stones that gathers the wind and throws it at the first foe to cross.

name: Billow Lattice
description: Hold a billowing lattice that shields the maker and swells to meet each blow.

name: Zephyr Phase
description: Pass through the open array like a breath of wind and come out clear of the foe's line.

name: Unbound Zephyr
description: Loose the whole open array as one great wind that sweeps every foe off its footing.

name: Squall Stone
description: Hold a stone against a rising squall and draw its force into the maker's arms.

name: Tempest Plate
description: Raise a plate that shakes under a storm of blows but does not break.

name: Tether Cord
description: Tether a foe to a fixed stone with a cord of qi that tightens whenever the foe pulls.

name: Squall Glyph
description: Etch a glyph that warns of a shift in the wind before any foe moves.

name: Tempest Flare
description: Flare the storm marks so that a hard wind spreads from the maker in all directions.

name: Tether Seal
description: Seal a foe's tether to the ground so the foe can move only in a short arc.

name: Squall Hold
description: Hold a squall of qi over a foe and beat down the foe's own technique with it.

name: Tempest Leap
description: Step on the front of a storm gust and cross the ground in a single bound.

name: Tempest Array
description: Lay an array of storm stones that breaks into a gale over the first foe to cross.

name: Squall Matrix
description: Hold a matrix that rages overhead and drives the foes' qi down toward the ground.

name: Tempest Mend
description: Let a gentle wind pass over allies in the crown so that it closes wounds and clears taint.

name: Storm Crown
description: Crown the maker in a storm of formation marks that whips outward and flays every foe nearby.
